testTarget.reason: MemoryMode is the spaced-repetition review UI (484 lines) and has zero tests. It manages card state, localStorage lesson selection, FSRS ratings, and completion flow — a regression here would break the core retention loop.

refactorCandidate.reason: Large component mixing UI, state, localStorage side effects, and debug logging. Extract setup screen, card review flow, and completion screen into smaller sub-components/hooks to make testing feasible.

notes: All explicitly-listed critical hooks/components (useAudioPlayer, useFurigana, useChatSession, AudioPlayer, JapanesePhrase, VoiceRecorder, HighlightedText) already have tests. Next biggest untested critical path is MemoryMode.
testNotes: MemoryMode.test.tsx existed but only covered the setup screen (and its hook mock lacked importUniqueVocabulary, so no session flow was reachable). New session-flow test covers: start session + vocabulary import, multi-lesson import, question/hidden answer, click + Space reveal, assessment buttons, all 4 keyboard rating shortcuts, next-card transition, completion screen, reset to setup, empty-deck completion, import failure resilience, keyboard shortcuts disabled in setup, and localStorage persistence/restore of selected lessons.
refactorNotes: Split 484-line MemoryMode.tsx into useMemorySession hook (state/effects/keyboard shortcuts), MemoryModeSetup/MemoryModeStudy/MemoryModeComplete presentational components, and memoryModeUtils (formatInterval, labels). Removed DEBUG console.log spam. Container is now ~115 lines. Public API and DOM unchanged; tsc clean; 36 MemoryMode tests pass; production build succeeds.
